speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) how are HDB rental housing eligibility criteria and rental rates affected by the increase in wages arising from the Progressive Wage Model; and (b) whether low-wage earners who may become ineligible for rental housing or who have to pay higher rents as a result of higher wages will be discouraged from renting HDB flats.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: When their rents are reviewed at tenancy renewal, HDB will also consider other factors such as household size, in addition to income, to ensure that the rent remains affordable.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Where necessary, HDB will exercise flexibility based on individual circumstances.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: With the uplifting of wages through the Progressive Wage Model, we hope that more lower-wage workers will be able to purchase homes of their own.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I wanted to reflect this ground feedback from employers and bosses of lower-income workers.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: They are telling me that when they increase the pay of the workers, for example, through compliance to PWM, some of the lower-wage workers were very worried, that, one, they will not be eligible for HDB rental flats because although it is mentioned that $1,500 is a guideline, I think, to many of them, from the official document, it does not sound like it is a guideline; it sounds like that was an income criterion for rental eligibility.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: In some of these cases, we have seen higher than the rate of salary increases.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: So, I hope that there can be found a way to communicate and assure, both the workers and their employers, that indeed what Minister of State Faishal has said, that there will be flexibility, that HDB will align the increase in wages for these lower-wage workers and the eligibility criteria for such important and useful benefits, like housing and other relevant social benefits.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We want to assure the Member that we will continue to do so and we want to help as many people as possible to have that housing option.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: What is the backlog waiting time now for rental flat allocation?
